name: Ammunition Canister [1]
summary: Ammunition Canister [1] is an ammunition box in the starter loadout.
role: Use the canister to place an ammunition box. The canister is removed from your inventory after you use it.
fun_facts: Both ammunition canister variants deploy the same universal ammo box.

name: Ammunition Canister [2]
summary: Ammunition Canister [2] is an ammunition box from the shop.
role: Use the canister to place an ammunition box for the team.
fun_facts: The canister puts ammunition at its deployment location. Select this location carefully.

name: RallyDrop
summary: RallyDrop is a tool that calls a vehicle to a nearby location.
role: Use RallyDrop to call the LTV-300. The RallyDrop gamepasses give access to more vehicles.
fun_facts: RallyDrop checks multiple spawn rings around the player, from 26 to 90 studs.
Available paint colors are Coyote, Green, Tan, and Grey.
